annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《城乡义务教育补助经费管理办法》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Measures for the Management of Urban and Rural Compulsory Education Subsidy Funds
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部 教育部 (Ministry of Finance; Ministry of Education)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Education measures governing central transfer funds for urban and rural compulsory education, covering fee waivers, school operating funds, teacher posts, and nutrition programs, with allocation, performance and oversight rules. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Central transfer funds for compulsory education run until 2030, subject to evaluation.
Funds cover fee waivers, textbooks, living subsidies, school operating costs and campus safety.
Provinces submit annual applications by end of February and are responsible for their accuracy.
Funds may not be used for balancing budgets, debt repayment or investment.
Performance management and supervision by regulatory bureaus, with sanctions for violations.
